ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Aegis Logistics Limited has commissioned a new 36,000 MT specialized Ammonia storage terminal at Pipavav Port, effectively expanding its operational capacity and potential revenue streams in terminalling services. While developed by Aegis Logistics, the terminal will subsequently be transferred to its step-down subsidiary, Aegis Terminal (Pipavav) Limited, a disclosed internal restructuring that does not present any immediate red flags. This development signifies strategic growth and asset expansion for the company.
